from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
W,H=800,420
img=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white')
d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
try:
    font=ImageFont.truetype('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf',40)
except Exception as e:
    font=None
    print('font load failed',e)
d.text((50,50),'During gesture: Target 01:23 / 02:34  Progress 56%',fill=(0,0,0),font=font)
img.save('/workspace/during_gesture.png')
img2=Image.new('RGB',(W,H),'white')
d2=ImageDraw.Draw(img2)
d2.text((50,50),'Post-gesture: Target 01:23 / 02:34  Progress 0%',fill=(0,0,0),font=font)
img2.save('/workspace/post_gesture.png')
print('Saved')
PY
